//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Improved Sign Editing -> Config

Enable Improved Sign Editing.//: Whether Improved Sign Editing is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart. Do not disable a mod that adds blocks or items to an existing world, they will be removed.

enableImprovedEditing.//: A global toggle whether the improved edtiting functionality should be enabled.

showImprovedEditingButton.//: Whether the Improved/Normal Editing button should be visible on the sign edit screen.
